answer: Because the timing is logged against the vertex challenge, the comet audit can replay the zephyr history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 147 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 3783 identities would post 2133 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
